Access means actual page data, which can include company prose while job listings still load. It does not establish job-list rendering or extraction completeness.

Access judgments use at most 12,000 sampled characters from output capped at 250,000 characters; no exhaustive quality or completeness claim.
Single dated live run, no retry. Platform clustering is not accounted for in per-page confidence intervals or paired significance.
